about.title: About Us
about.intro: Merasim360 is a marketplace that makes it easy to find the right vendor across Turkey for weddings, engagements, henna nights, circumcision ceremonies, birthdays and many other special occasions.
about.missionText: To help people organize the most special moments of their lives with a trustworthy, transparent and easy experience — and to help vendors connect with the right customers and grow their business.
about.howText: Every business on our platform is reviewed and approved by our team before going live, so our users connect with verified, genuine vendors.
about.freeText: Merasim360 is completely free for both customers and businesses right now. Our priority is building a real community first — optional support and advanced features for vendors will come later.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data we collect when you use Merasim360 and how we use it.

sections.heading: Data We Collect
sections.body: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and optionally your phone number. If you register as a vendor, your business details (name, description, contact info, images) are also stored.

sections.heading: How We Use Data
sections.body: Your data is used only to manage your account, forward your quote requests to the relevant vendor, and improve the platform. Your data is never sold to third parties.

sections.heading: Cookies & Analytics
sections.body: We use essential technical data for session management. For visitor statistics we use Umami analytics, self-hosted on our own server and collecting no personal data — we do not use third-party trackers like Google Analytics.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: Your password is never stored in plain text (it's hashed with bcrypt). All traffic is encrypted with HTTPS. Your data is hosted on our own servers, not transferred to third-party cloud services.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or object to the processing of your data. You can exercise these rights by reaching out via our contact page.

sections.heading: Account Deletion
sections.body: If you'd like to delete your account and associated data, contact us via our contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using Merasim360, you agree to the following terms.

sections.heading: Service Description
sections.body: Merasim360 is a directory/marketplace platform connecting users looking for vendors for weddings, engagements and other special events with businesses offering those services. No payment or booking is processed through the platform — contact and agreements happen directly between the parties.

sections.heading: Account Responsibility
sections.body: You are responsible for all activity on your account. Do not share your password with anyone.

sections.heading: Vendor Obligations
sections.body: Businesses registering as vendors commit to providing accurate and up-to-date information. Listings with misleading or false information will be rejected or removed by admins.

sections.heading: Content Moderation
sections.body: All vendor applications and reviews go through admin approval. The platform reserves the right to reject or remove inappropriate content.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: Merasim360 is not responsible for the quality of services provided by vendors listed on the platform. Vendor selection and agreement terms are entirely the user's responsibility.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: The platform is currently completely free for both customers and businesses. Any future optional paid services will be announced in advance.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: These terms may be updated from time to time. The current version is always published on this page.

faq.q1: Is requesting a quote on Merasim360 free?
faq.a1: Yes. The platform is currently completely free for both customers and vendors, with no hidden fees.
faq.a2: Every vendor application is individually reviewed by our team before going live. Every vendor with the verified badge has gone through this process.
faq.q3: Is booking or payment handled through the platform?
faq.a3: No. Merasim360 is a directory/marketplace — contact and agreements happen directly between you and the vendor, no payment is taken through the platform.
faq.q4: Can I find vendors anywhere in Turkey?
faq.a4: Merasim360 operates across Turkey. If there's no vendor in your city yet, you can also be the first to list your business for that category and city.
faq.q5: How can I review a vendor?
faq.a5: You can leave a rating and review for a vendor you've worked with using your account. Reviews are published after admin approval.
